args.body: Hi, yes, we'll get a second quote from another contractor for comparison and will report back once we have it. Sorry too: our earlier email (6 April) attached the check-out inspection report instead of the estimate. The correct estimate is attached. It is from Alder Compliance for £1,370.00 (no VAT itemised), covering bathroom sanding/filling/damp paint, painting all walls and ceiling in the main room, new bathroom lino, plug socket and shelf repair, and a new bathroom tap. It says the bedroom carpet can stay, although the check-out report records burn damage, and it includes a tap replacement where we only asked for a drip repair. We'll ask the second contractor to price each item separately, including the carpet. Nothing is approved yet. Please hold off on a decision on the first estimate; we'll update you by 11 April.
